placedsticks.guide.name: Field Notes
placedsticks.guide.subtitle: Rods and stalks
placedsticks.guide.landing: Sticks and bamboo can stand in the world as thin rods. Three fit in one block: one along each axis.
placedsticks.guide.cat.placing.desc: How to put sticks and bamboo into the world.
placedsticks.guide.page.sticks.1: Right-click a block with a stick. The rod is placed in the empty cell along the face you clicked: the top or bottom stands it upright, a side lays it flat.$(br2)Click the rod on another face to add a second or third. One block holds one rod per axis.
placedsticks.guide.page.sticks.2: Breaking the block returns every stick that was in it. An axe is faster. A chest, door, or other used block still opens if you are not sneaking; sneak to place a stick on it.
placedsticks.guide.page.bamboo.1: Bamboo follows the same three-axis rule, and the stalk is a little thicker.$(br2)A normal click on ground where bamboo can grow still plants vanilla bamboo. Sneak to force a decorative stalk there. On stone, or any spot bamboo cannot grow, the stalk is placed without sneaking.
placedsticks.guide.page.bamboo.2: This book is crafted from a book and a stick. It is given once, the first time you enter a world.
